name: Standaard Opdrachtgeversverklaring (Wet DBA)
description: Belastingdienst-conform opdrachtgeversverklaring template rendered from OpdrachtgeversVerklaring fields. Generates the standard opdrachtgever declaration document per REQ-DPA-004. Triggered on the OpdrachtgeversVerklaring overeenkomen lifecycle transition; the output URI is written back to verklaringDocumentUri. Render flow is docudesk-side per ADR-022 — shillinq declares the template and field bindings only.

name: IB47-formulier 2026 (Belastingdienst XML)
description: IB47 jaaropgaaf form template rendering per the Belastingdienst XML schema 2026 per REQ-DPA-006. Groups IB47Record entries per (belastingjaar, opdrachtgeverId) into a single XML batch. The rendered XML is transmitted via the belastingdienst-ib47-nl openconnector source (referenced by output-channel). Every transmission writes an audit-trail event with submission hash and response status per ADR-022.

templateMeta.legalBasis: Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 art. 22a + IB47-schema 2026
